definitions.previousDayClose: Close of the last 15m bar of the prior NSE session
definitions.dayTrend: Session close vs that day's 09:15 open
definitions.nextDayHigh: Highest 15m high on that session; time is the first 15m candle that printed it
definitions.nextDayLow: Lowest 15m low on that session; time is the first 15m candle that printed it
definitions.candle0915Color: 09:15 15m candle body: green if close > open, red if close < open
definitions.candle0915HighCrossedPrevCloseUp: True when the 09:15 candle high is above the previous day's close
definitions.candle0915LowCrossedPrevCloseDown: True when the 09:15 candle low is below the previous day's close
